title: ambush:lease:v1
description:
One ContainmentLease, on open, in the case channel. Only four of the twelve destructive action kinds ever produce one (crates/swarm-runtime/src/containment.rs:54-63).

CARRIES ContainmentLeaseRecord, NOT ContainmentLeaseView. The View's two extra fields, remaining_ms and expired, are computed against an observation instant (crates/swarm-runtime-http/src/http/containment.rs:72-88) and this card is immutable; baking them in would freeze a countdown at its publish value forever. The console recomputes both from expires_at_ms and renders them as two separate elements (INV-06).

Tier 0. A ContainmentLease carries no signature; governance_receipt_id is an id, not a receipt, and resolving it is not a verification.

issuer.description: WHO PRODUCED THE FACT. See the envelope's `issuer` for who published it.

emitted_at_ms.description: The RuntimeEvent's own emitted_at_ms, carried through unchanged. THE SORT KEY for every Perch surface. The Nostr event's `created_at` is a transport timestamp stamped at publish, because MAX_TIMESTAMP_DRIFT_SECS is 900 and REJECTS (crates/buzz-relay/src/handlers/ingest.rs:2224-2231) and `created_at` is inside the Nostr signature, so a spooled card carrying its true emit time becomes permanently unpublishable fifteen minutes after it was produced.

receipt_card_id.description: Nostr event id of the ambush:receipt:v1 card. Also the `e` tag.

lease.description: ContainmentLeaseRecord, crates/swarm-response/src/containment.rs:101-118 — the private persisted form ContainmentLease serializes into via `#[serde(into = "ContainmentLeaseRecord", try_from = "ContainmentLeaseRecord")]` at :129-130. `deny_unknown_fields` on the record and a TryFrom that re-checks expires_at_ms > issued_at_ms make an unbounded lease a parse error rather than a lease that expires at the epoch.
lease.x-carried-note: This object is a domain type carried VERBATIM. The Rust wire crate names the type rather than redeclaring its fields, so a field added upstream reaches the wire with no edit and a field removed upstream is a compile error. tools/check-perch-wire-parity.sh skips its property names on the Rust side for exactly that reason, and the golden vectors plus this schema are what hold the shape.

ttl_source.description: Carried so no surface renders the wrong TTL. The containment lease's TTL default is 900,000 ms (crates/swarm-core/src/config/defaults.rs:23-27), NOT the 60,000 ms policy.lease_ttl_ms at rulesets/default.yaml:94, which is the CapabilityLease's authorization window. rulesets/default.yaml cannot set this one: the file is digest-signed and the block is absent by design (crates/swarm-core/src/config/runtime.rs:88-93).
